_comment: Gale waving classes for vanilla. Most vanilla blocks are found by class (leaves, bushes, vines, kelp, seagrass); this file names the rest and the exceptions. Resource packs and mods can add files under assets/<namespace>/waving/. Entries: block id, id[property=value,...] or namespace:*. Later packs win; "replace": true ignores lower packs' copies of the same file.
